usual_baseline: Around half miss 36 hours: 49% delayed [1130, 1324], 41% within 36 hours [1132], mean 43.68–49 hours [1391, 1291]. Tariff met in 21–45.7% [1131, 1132, 1391]. Warfarinised patients wait longer, mean 53.71 hours [1298]; DOAC patients median 39 hours [1501]. Theatre space causes 28% of delays [1130].
fix_that_works: More theatre time. Two extra morning lists: mean 49 to 27 hours, within 36 hours 41% to 78% [1132, 1291]. Anaesthetic 'hot week': 54% to 87.5%, tariff 45.7% to 84% [1391]. Daytime emergency theatre: delays 49% to 26% [1130, 1324]. Nurse-led IV vitamin K in ED: mean 53.71 to 37.61 hours [1298], median 49.7 to 33.9 hours [1131].
fix_that_fails: An anaesthesia outreach service sped consults (39% to 67% within 24 hours) but not surgery: within 48 hours 38% to 51.6%, p=0.904 [1415]. INR sample education cut rejections only 16.5% to 11.1%, not significant [1523]. Echo report acknowledgement fell 83.3% to 70.6% [1536]. Theatre space remained a major cause [1270].
consultant_advice: Time to theatre is heavily audited and the answer is usually theatre capacity. Don't just measure the breach rate. Audit the causes you can fix: anticoagulant reversal, DOAC protocols (few units had one [1501]), and INR sample rejection. Report cause-specific delay, not only the headline figure.
